Two runs of the PMC block, 2026-09-20'), its own section at :144-148 already contains the correct reading, and pass 1 read it closely and chose to treat it as the refuting authority rather than a site to edit. Issue bodies cannot be edited by a lane at all. Bouncing the PR for a file no pass named would be moving the goalposts.

observations_not_blocking.what: A case range containing 0x200 without starting at it still passes the write guard. Measured: `case 0x1FC ... 0x2FC:` in pmc_write -> 8 checks, 0 failures, exit 0.
observations_not_blocking.why_not_a_finding: The regex alternates on NV_PMC_ENABLE|0[xX]0*200|512 followed by ':' or '...', so it catches ranges beginning at the register, not ranges spanning it. #190's own block is 0x204-0x2FC, which excludes 0x200, so the natural arm for the follow-up work is caught by neither needing to be. Recorded so the guard's reach is written down somewhere other than the regex.
